name: Armor Durability
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: GregoryAM
description: Shows your equipped armor icons and durability bars to the left of the hotbar.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Draws each worn armour piece's icon with a durability bar in a row left of the hotbar (and left of the offhand slot), gui x 19..89, y 221..237 at 1280x720 scale 3; nothing while no armour is worn.
